Started placing their blowers on the Phase 3 building.
Continued pumping water from the south lagoon.

reports.notes:

Hayden also touched up Cells 3 and 4 with additional epoxy. The remaining cells are currently looking dry.
Completed a walkthrough with Weaver. Laura identified that the drawings need to be updated to show all instrument lines running to the H2S tanks and the GC on the DVO pad.
Started filling the digesters with raw manure. Current goal is to reach 15%.

Finished tying in the 4-inch pipe and installing the ﬂow meters on the Kansas pad. Still need to install the pipe supports and pour the concrete pad.
Backfilled the 10-inch pipe tie-in to the blower at the Phase 3 building.

subs.items:
Finished installing all boots and completed backfill work on the south lagoon.
Cleaned up the area and removed/trash-disposed of the old liner.

subs.items:
Ran electrical conduit on the Kansas gas pad.
Stored the VFD for BL2 inside the small electrical building.

reports.notes:
Ed (Hartman) continued touch-up painting and is adding the final base inside the office building.
Hakeem from Casne is still on site installing servers for all the TVs.
The cyclone for the PAQUES system is expected to arrive on site Friday.
Started spark testing the south lagoon. A total of 28 panels were tested, with 4 leaks detected. A map showing the locations of the holes will be provided to EFI for repairs.

subs.name: Bennett
subs.items:
Welding ﬂanges and installing them on the piping revisions on the DMT slab.
Started hydro-vac work for the biogas stub-out on the south lagoon.
Finished cleaning all piping on the DMT slab. The piping still needs to be reassembled so they can perform the hydrogen test.

reports.notes:
Continued feeding the DVO with raw manure. Approximately 100,000 gallons were fed after all of the inlet pumps became clogged. Dominic and Bennett spent approximately 10 hours unclogging the inlet pipes.
Heat exchangers arrived on site and were set on the PAQUES pad.
Placed the CAT generator on the Phase 3 concrete slab along with the transformer.
We are going to add two blowout lines to address the clogging issue one before the check valve and one after the check valve. This is the solution we are going with moving forward instead of adding agitators.

subs.name: Bennett
subs.items:
Continued working on the Phase 3 piping modifications on the DMT slab.
Continued installing ﬂow meters, valves, and the PRV.

subs.items:
Worked on laying conduit for BL1 and the control valves.

Bennett continued working on the piping around the BL1 blower. They prefabed piping for the paques. And continued doing the piping around the lagoon.
MJE was on site and set the paques tank and other equipment.
Eck has the under ground conduits in for fiber box, bop panel and gas train instruments as well as the light pole. Eck is also working on control wiring.

Cimarron came on site to finish wiring the valves for ﬂare mode. They are having some issues wiring the actuators.
Titan was on site erecting the Phase 3 building and installing beams.
Continued feeding the DVO with raw manure. Still experiencing issues with the pumps getting clogged.
